name: open-quantum-safe/liboqs
description: A C library for quantum-safe cryptographic algorithms including post-quantum key encapsulation mechanisms (KEMs) and digital signature schemes. Part of the Open Quantum Safe initiative under the Linux Foundation's Post-Quantum Cryptography Alliance.
score_rationale: Essential post-quantum cryptography reference library with 2.8k stars, actively maintained and serving as the upstream for many PQC integrations.
